gloss: to become hazy; to blur; to be overshadowed

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {霞|かす}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to become misty; to become hazy
definitions.explanation: For the air or a view to become unclear because of mist, haze, dust or distance.

definitions.gloss: to become dim; to blur (of eyesight)
definitions.explanation: For one's vision to become unclear, from tears, tiredness or age; the subject is usually the eyes.

definitions.gloss: to be overshadowed; to pale in comparison
definitions.explanation: For something to seem less noticeable or impressive next to something better.

examples.english: My eyes have started to blur from tiredness.
As you get older, your eyes blur more easily when you read small print.

notes:
An intransitive godan verb. Haze over a landscape (sense 1), blurred eyesight (sense 2) and being outshone (sense 3) all come from the image of ⟦{霞|かすみ}→霞：05042_kasumi⟧, spring haze.

WRITING:
- Also written {翳|かす}む, an uncommon kanji; often written in kana as かすむ.

ASPECT (ている):
{霞|かす}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes a current state of being hazy or blurred.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{霞|かす}む (something becomes hazy / is overshadowed)
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{霞|かす}む (pales before ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{霞|かす}む (eyes blur)
- ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{霞|かす}む (scenery becomes hazy)
- {霞|かす}んで⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ (looks hazy)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{霞|かすみ}→霞：05042_kasumi⟧ (noun form) means haze or mist
